name: fastMRI: Raw k-Space and DICOM Magnetic Resonance Imaging Dataset
description: A large-scale open research benchmark of raw MRI k-space measurements and reconstructed clinical DICOM images from knee and brain examinations, developed by NYU Grossman School of Medicine and Meta AI Research to pioneer deep learning algorithms for accelerated MRI acquisitions. Contains raw multi-coil and single-coil k-space pulse sequences. Safeguard notice: Open solely for non-commercial research and academic advancement; users must agree to the fastMRI Data Use Agreement; redistributing raw or processed tensors is prohibited.
